name: Eeris Hotel
source:
Welcome to Eeris Hotel!

You, a human, mysteriously appeared in a strange world, with living monsters?! Uh-oh, and you just learned that your species is banned here—learned the hard way.

As you successfully flee from law enforcers, you fall unconscious in front of a hotel. When you wake up, you're surrounded by 9 mysterious creatures. All of them are also hiding from the government, and found refuge in this hotel for fugitives. But why?

Together, with the love interest of your choice, you'll discover the secrets behind your arrival, learn about their past, and help them get the happy ending they deserve—or not.

[From [url=https://carmincrypt-studio.itch.io/eeris-hotel-chapterone]itch.io[/url]]
